title: enhanced-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflows
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Improve safety and observability for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts by adding a modular autorollback workflow that supports multi-metric thresholds, staged probing, and deterministic safety windows. The change consolidates existing ad-hoc rollback logic into a single extensible engine and adds observability hooks and e2e tests to reduce flakiness in production rollouts. Key goals: 1) Enable composite metric rules (latency + error-rate + quality regression) for rollback decisions; 2) Add staged probing to reduce false positives from transient spikes; 3) Introduce per-rollout safety windows and cooldowns; 4) Add shadow traffic probing with passive validation and automatic abort if shadow metrics diverge; 5) Provide clear tracing and per-step events to drive Console dashboards and alerting. This PR touches the rollout engine, controller reconciler, policy DSL, and adds a new suite of unit/integration tests and end-to-end canary scenarios. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs continue to work; new fields are additive. Related: ENG-11234 (autorollback rewrite), ENG-11567 (observability for rollouts).
